# Codex rollout fixture

`codex-0.169.0.jsonl` was extracted from a real local Codex CLI 0.169.0 session
on 2026-11-13. Message bodies and IDs were replaced; private metadata, paths,
tool arguments, reasoning and encrypted content were removed. Envelope timestamps,
record kinds, role/phase fields, content block kinds and usage numbers preserve
observed structure. It is a representative selection, not a complete transcript.
